newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's cement sector to grow by 3.0 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's cement sector to grow by 3.0 pct in 1997.

text.p: Morocco's cement sector, which has a total capacity of 9.0 million tonnes, is expected to grow by an average 3.0 percent in 1997, nearly unchanged compared with 1996, a CGEM businessmen confederation spokesman said on Monday.
"Despite strains such as heavy transport costs, the cement sector is expected to grow by 3.0 percent this year or nearly the same trend in 1996," the spokesman said.

The sector represents an annual turnover of 5.0 billion dirhams ($531 million). It has drawn in recent years interest of foreign companies which have purchased stakes in eight out of the 10 existing cement firms, he said.

French group Lafarge Coppee together with Morocco's conglomerate Societe Nationale d'Investissement own 50 percent of Lafarge Maroc while Switzerland's Holderbank has 51 percent stake in Ciments de L'Oriental.
Most cement output is sold on the domestic market with only five percent devoted to exports.
